title: gallery block props
description: A gallery (« Galerie »): several images shown together. Presentations: grid (in columns, cropped to one ratio), mosaic (in columns at their own proportions), carousel (one at a time with its caption, Previous and Next, a thumbnail per image) and compare (exactly two images, the second over the first, with a slider to move between them: before and after).
x-ai-instructions: Use a gallery when the images are read together: variants to compare, examples of one category, the steps of a result. Each image needs alt (what it shows that matters here) unless it is decorative, and a caption when the learner must tell the images apart. compare takes exactly two images of the same framing: the first is before (or left), the second after. Keep grids to 2 to 8 images and a carousel to 5 (learners often stop at the first ones: W_ITEMS_MANY); more belong in separate parts. Set zoom when a detail matters (a screenshot, a map): each image opens at full size.

presentation.description: grid: columns of images cropped to ratio; mosaic: columns of images at their own proportions; carousel: one image at a time, whole in a frame of ratio, with Previous, Next and thumbnails; compare: two images, one over the other, and a slider between them.

id.description: Stable id of the image in the gallery (translations name it).

alt.description: What the image shows. Required unless decorative is true.

caption.description: A short caption under the image (compare: the label of its side).

focus.description: Where the subject is, kept in view when the image is cropped.

decorative.description: True only if the image carries no information.

columns.description: grid and mosaic: columns on wide screens (fewer on narrow ones).

ratio.description: grid: the shape every image is cropped to, around its focus; carousel: the frame every image is shown whole in.

zoom.description: grid, mosaic and carousel: each image opens at full size in the player's lightbox, with its caption, and previous and next between the images.

caption.description: A caption for the whole gallery.

generated.description: True if images of the gallery were produced by an AI model; the player shows a mark and the build report lists it.
